en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad,f rom Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara, 
Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘(For adultery), the one who is not married, he should be whipped one hundred lashes, and he would not be exiled, and the one who has a slave girl and did not copulate with her, he would be whipped one hundred lashes and exiled’.
